entities.summary: The Church of Our Lady of Loreto is an ornate church in Praga, a district of Warsaw, Poland, on the east bank of the Vistula River. The church stands on Ratuszowa Street and is Praga's oldest monument. What may be seen today is a former chapel that on its south side was once attached to a baroque church and a Bernardine monastery.
